beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Evidence checking must also distinguish an asserted tool result from an actual execution.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: For agents, the evaluation may need to inspect trajectories rather than final answers alone.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The surrounding system determines what evidence is available and what actions a verdict permits.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Readers can use these chapters to locate the boundary between evaluation data and evaluator authority.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The applications move across science, software, education, professional review, and other consequential settings.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Their variety does not imply that one universal rubric should govern every domain.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Some judgments require plural standards, specialist evidence, or an explicit capacity to abstain.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Aesthetic evaluation makes the limits of one supposedly neutral score especially visible.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The book uses these differences to test its architecture against more than one convenient benchmark.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Its reader gains come from comparing requirements rather than copying a verdict between unrelated contexts.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The institutional chapters ask what happens when someone contests an automated evaluation.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: A recorded reason matters only if the surrounding policy permits meaningful reconsideration.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The book connects appeals, abstention, oversight, and continuing measurement with technical design.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: It also asks who evaluates the institutions that install and maintain the judges.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: These questions prevent accountability from shrinking into a dashboard of internal performance scores.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The central argument returns here: the evaluator must remain visible to evaluation itself.
